name: nabsun
description: A browser for AI: Chromium as an execution environment for agents, with a bundled local model and pluggable backends (Claude, Codex/OpenAI, Ollama).
author: Naveen Kumar Alavilli

scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run verify:cli && npm run verify:browse && npm run verify:page && npm run verify:agent && npm run verify:mcp && npm run verify:local
scripts.dist: node scripts/check-release-payload.mjs && npm run build && npm run icon && electron-builder
scripts.dist:win: node scripts/check-release-payload.mjs && npm run build && npm run icon && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/check-release-payload.mjs && npm run build && npm run icon && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:linux: node scripts/check-release-payload.mjs && npm run build && npm run icon && electron-builder --linux
